title: Contents Packout & Storage Booking Rule: One Open Job per Loss Address and the Contents Coverage
content:
## Rule

1. No other contents job of the same customer for the same loss address may be open when a new job is booked.
2. A job is open in every status except closed and cancelled.
3. Contents work is billed under the contents coverage of the claim file, separate from the dwelling coverage that pays mitigation and rebuild: a contents-coverage carrier payment is posted only to the contents job of the claim file, and dwelling-coverage payments are never posted to a contents job.

This rule governs booking a new Contents Packout & Storage job and posting carrier payments to a contents job.

## What the system must show

The test at booking reads the company's own job records, matching on the same customer and the same loss address; it is decided before the new job is booked. The statuses that count as open are scheduled, authorized, in custody, return scheduled, returned and invoiced.

| Existing job of the same customer at the same loss address | Status | May a new job be booked at that address? |
|---|---|---|
| none | — | yes |
| one | closed | yes |
| one | cancelled | yes |
| one | scheduled, authorized, in custody, return scheduled, returned or invoiced | no |

## Coverage separation

| Carrier payment | May it be posted to a contents job? |
|---|---|
| contents-coverage payment on the claim file | only to the contents job of that claim file |
| dwelling-coverage payment | never |

**Hypothetical illustration.** A customer whose earlier contents job at a given address shows invoiced status still has an open job there, so a second job at that address cannot be booked; a job at a different address of the same customer is not affected.
